notes: Job LOADPADB step STEP01 (DFSRRC00 PARM='BMP,PAUDBLOD,PSBPAUTB'): a BMP. PROCEDURE DIVISION USING IO-PCB-MASK PAUTBPCB, then ENTRY 'DLITCBL' USING PAUTBPCB lists only the DB PCB -- IMS passes the I/O PCB first (PSB PSBPAUTB, CMPAT=YES), so the ENTRY list is the division's list minus its first (#5233). It loads the empty pending-authorization database DBPAUTP0 (HIDAM: root PAUTSUM0, child PAUTDTL1) with CALL 'CBLTDLI' ISRT from INFILE1 (the roots) and INFILE2 (each child behind its root's key: GU the root, then ISRT the child). INFILE1 / INFILE2 are not in the corpus: generated from the program's own record layouts, INFILE1's last PA-ACCT-ID repeats the first (ISRT root -> II) and INFILE2's ROOT-SEG-KEY cycles over INFILE1's keys plus one with no root (GU miss); keys are positive because the CBLTDLI model refuses a P-field qualification whose operands are not both valid with one positive sign. The I/O PCB mask is PIC X(1) here and the program never reads it (the same ASSUMPTION as CBPAUP0C). The DL/I model is register family I (tests/equivalence/ims/ggdli.c, cobolrt/dli/DetDli.java), #4893.
